schema.description: UpdateWorkspaceScriptRequest saves the whole workspace script form.

enabled.description: Whether sessions created from now on run the script.

variables.description: The complete set of variables; a key left out is removed.

items.description: WorkspaceScriptVariableInput is one variable as the editor saves it.

isSecret.description: Encrypt at rest and mask in the UI.

key.description: Environment variable name. Names starting with "RDE_" are refused.

value.description:
The value. For a protected variable that already has a stored value,
empty keeps the stored one.
